title: End Date for Counting the Final Month of an Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
The days an **Entrance Fee Agreement** ran into its final month of occupancy are counted to an end date fixed as follows: where the independent living apartment named in the agreement was vacated before the termination date, the count runs to the vacate date; where the agreement terminated on the death of the resident and the apartment was not vacated before that date, the count runs to the date of death and the date of death itself is counted as a day; in every other case the count runs to the termination date.

## Records read

- The vacate date of the apartment is the one on the **Independent Living Residency Agreement** paired with the Entrance Fee Agreement.
- The termination date and the termination reason (death, the resident's notice or Larkspur for cause) are those on the Entrance Fee Agreement.

## End-date table

| Apartment vacated before the termination date | Terminated on the resident's death | End of the count |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | The vacate date |
| No | Yes | The date of death, itself counted as a day |
| No | No | The termination date |

When the count runs to a vacate date, the days counted never fall below 0.

## Hypothetical cases (last month already amortized began 10 May; thirty days deducted under the thirty-day-month convention)

| Case | End of the count | Calendar days from 10 May | Days run |
|---|---|---|---|
| Notice termination on 30 June, apartment vacated 18 June | 18 June | 39 | 9 |
| Death on 18 June, apartment not vacated before that date | 18 June, counted as a day | 39 | 10 |
| Notice termination on 18 June, apartment not vacated before that date | 18 June | 39 | 9 |
